retrieval_policy.face: enabled; use facial sidecar face_quality_weight; requires at least 2 accepted facial frames in the motion unit
retrieval_policy.head: enabled; combine coarse head pose reliability with facial quality so off-frame/scenery/camera-pan spans do not masquerade as reusable head behavior
retrieval_policy.body_support: enabled only as auxiliary anchoring; not a primary gesture source
retrieval_policy.left_hand: disabled for retrieval from this source
retrieval_policy.right_hand: disabled for retrieval from this source
retrieval_policy.both_hands: disabled for retrieval from this source
retrieval_policy.generic_whole_upper: disabled for retrieval from this source

quality_policy.global_hard_exclusion: manual semantic exclusions only; none confirmed at this stage
quality_policy.face_eligibility: at least 2 accepted facial frames after facial-quality audit; this is a structural descriptor requirement, not an arbitrary confidence threshold
quality_policy.hands: recorded diagnostically but retrieval weight forced to zero for this source role
quality_policy.facial_hard_suspects: excluded from facial descriptors only; they do not hard-exclude the underlying base motion unit

notes: This source is intentionally role-specific. Missing/off-frame hands are not a source failure.
Units with zero facial quality remain in the base behavior profile but are not eligible for face/head retrieval.
Camera/scenery spans are naturally suppressed for head retrieval because head weight is gated by facial quality.
